description:
🪰 20-Pack Clothes & Carpet Moth Trap Refill Pads – Monitoring-Only Solution for Wardrobes & Storage

Protect your home and belongings with our non-toxic pheromone trap refills, designed for monitoring moth activity only. These pads help detect infestations early before serious damage occurs. They contain a slow-release pheromone attractant that targets adult male moths such as Tineola bisselliella, disrupting the breeding cycle in a safe, natural way.

✔ Suitable for Common Indoor Moth Types:
Clothes moths, carpet moths, case-bearing moths, brown house moths, Indian meal moths, Mediterranean flour moths, cacao moths, and more.

✔ Safe & Easy to Use:
No pesticides or harmful chemicals – these pads are completely safe for kids, pets, and the environment. Their slim profile makes them ideal for discreet use in wardrobes, drawers, kitchen cupboards, lofts, and storage areas.

Package Includes:
20 x Refill Pads for Clothes & Carpet Moth Monitoring
Pad Dimensions: 13.4 cm (L) x 5.8 cm (W)
Packed in recyclable eco-friendly packaging.

For Monitoring Use Only – This product is intended solely for the detection of moth activity and is not classified as a biocidal product under GB BPR / EU BPR. It does not contain active substances for pest control.
